items.name: DFA
items.summary: A sparse deterministic finite automaton (DFA) with variable sized states.

methods.name: always_match
methods.summary: Create a new DFA that matches every input.

methods.name: as_ref
methods.summary: Cheaply return a borrowed version of this sparse DFA. Specifically, the DFA returned always uses `&[u8]` for its transitions.

methods.name: byte_classes
methods.summary: Returns the equivalence classes that make up the alphabet for this DFA.

methods.name: from_bytes
methods.summary: Safely deserialize a sparse DFA with a specific state identifier representation. Upon success, this returns both the deserialized DFA and the number of bytes read from the given slice. Namely, the contents of the slice beyond the DFA are n…

methods.name: from_bytes_unchecked
methods.signature: unsafe fn from_bytes_unchecked(slice: &'a [u8]) -> Result<(DFA<&'a [u8]>, usize), DeserializeError>
methods.summary: Deserialize a DFA with a specific state identifier representation in constant time by omitting the verification of the validity of the sparse transitions.

methods.name: match_pattern
methods.signature: fn match_pattern(&self, id: StateID, match_index: usize) -> PatternID

methods.name: memory_usage
methods.summary: Returns the memory usage, in bytes, of this DFA.

methods.name: never_match
methods.summary: Create a new sparse DFA that never matches any input.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Parse the given regular expression using a default configuration and return the corresponding sparse DFA.

methods.name: new_many
methods.summary: Parse the given regular expressions using a default configuration and return the corresponding multi-DFA.

methods.name: next_state
methods.signature: fn next_state(&self, current: StateID, input: u8) -> StateID

methods.name: next_state_unchecked
methods.signature: unsafe fn next_state_unchecked(&self, current: StateID, input: u8) -> StateID

methods.name: set_prefilter
methods.summary: Set or unset the prefilter attached to this DFA.

methods.name: start_kind
methods.summary: Returns the starting state configuration for this DFA.

methods.name: starts_for_each_pattern
methods.summary: Returns true only if this DFA has starting states for each pattern.

methods.name: to_bytes_big_endian
methods.summary: Serialize this DFA as raw bytes to a `Vec<u8>` in big endian format.

methods.name: to_bytes_little_endian
methods.summary: Serialize this DFA as raw bytes to a `Vec<u8>` in little endian format.

methods.name: to_bytes_native_endian
methods.summary: Serialize this DFA as raw bytes to a `Vec<u8>` in native endian format.

methods.name: to_owned
methods.summary: Return an owned version of this sparse DFA. Specifically, the DFA returned always uses `Vec<u8>` for its transitions.

methods.name: write_to_big_endian
methods.summary: Serialize this DFA as raw bytes to the given slice, in big endian format. Upon success, the total number of bytes written to `dst` is returned.

methods.name: write_to_len
methods.summary: Return the total number of bytes required to serialize this DFA.

methods.name: write_to_little_endian
methods.summary: Serialize this DFA as raw bytes to the given slice, in little endian format. Upon success, the total number of bytes written to `dst` is returned.

methods.name: write_to_native_endian
methods.summary: Serialize this DFA as raw bytes to the given slice, in native endian format. Upon success, the total number of bytes written to `dst` is returned.
